supersedes: routing_merge_contract@2.0.0 for the 巅池-Agent小助手 natural-language path
goal: Use GPT-5.6-Luna as the main Agent for natural-language understanding while keeping one deterministic Router in the middle of Agent/menu/card requests and bounded executors.

architecture.access_layer: Feishu access control, Runtime Principal resolution, message normalization
architecture.natural_language_path: Feishu -> GPT-5.6-Luna main Agent -> AgentDecision -> middle Router
architecture.deterministic_path: Feishu menu or trusted card -> middle Router
architecture.ordinary_chat: GPT-5.6-Luna replies directly without entering the Router

invariants: Router appears once in the runtime path and never performs natural-language classification.
The Codex OAuth main Agent honors provider-scoped proxy configuration on NAS and never assumes direct chatgpt.com egress.
AgentDecision contains a capability id and goal but cannot name an arbitrary provider or executor.
Only the deterministic catalog maps a capability to an implementation.
Menu and card callbacks use the same Router Interface as the main Agent.
Untrusted card callbacks cannot execute capabilities.
A main Agent handoff must be approved by the middle Router before transfer_to_* executes.
H5 navigation is reversible and does not create a task until the user explicitly confirms execution.

When the main Agent has a complete media prompt in real conversation context and the user explicitly confirms generation, execute.image or execute.video starts media_route directly with the complete prompt instead of reopening H5.

After the middle Router approves execute.image or execute.video, the executor consumes the approved capability, goal, and parameters directly and never reclassifies that goal with legacy trigger regexes.
Legacy media trigger regexes apply only to unstructured messages in legacy_front mode and never override or veto a middle Router decision.
Menu-only and incomplete media requests remain workspace.image or workspace.video navigation and never infer a prompt from a confirmation phrase alone.
Harness owns task lifecycle and settlement; Router and Advanced Executors never own scheduling.

acceptance_tests.title: Unknown capabilities and untrusted cards are denied
Middle mode bypasses legacy natural-language classification
AstrBot subagent handoffs require Router approval
Confirmed media context executes directly without legacy reclassification while incomplete requests remain workspace navigation
